claims.statement: Artificial Analysis lists Sonnet 5.5 at all five efforts on Intelligence Index v4.3.2: low 36 ($0.41/task), medium 41 ($0.59/task), high 47 ($1.08/task), xhigh 52 ($2.74/task), max 56 ($7.60/task).
claims.implication: The low and medium index rows provide direct launch-day evidence for task settings that previously lacked low-effort observations. Treat them as publisher-run, pre-release deployment results and keep them separate from the later public-model rerun.
